invariants.rationale: Returning null for List<WriteStatus> is likely avoided in Java APIs; empty list preferred.
The method requires a valid (non-null, non-empty) instant time for write operations.
Caller must pass a non-null record list to upsert; null records would likely fail early.
The method's contract guarantees a List<WriteStatus> result.
List.size() is always non-negative in Java.
